svg.title: Autobot Command Center prototype page map
svg.desc: High-level visual storyboard showing the Command Center home page and four read-only drill-down pages: Outcomes, Prime Now, Evaluations and Resources, and Next Bets.
svg.text: Read-only visual outcomes plane · page-to-page prototype structure

g.text: One Prime lane · evidence before decoration
What landed · what is happening · what is next
Outcome claims grouped by evidence—not activity volume
Voice core · validated latency and interruption handling
Provider quota · unsupported by authoritative API
Clicking evidence leaves the Command Center for the canonical Wiki or immutable artifact.
A timestamped operational snapshot—not a fictional workforce
Phase: visual structure and evidence contract
Discrete states only · no fake percentages
If the heartbeat expires, Active automatically becomes Stale—never “live-looking.”
Comparable results and observed capability—not marketing claims
Future initiatives selected for decisions—not a backlog dump
Decision: approve a bounded intranet pilot
Reason: private MVP must prove value first
Summaries, readiness and decisions remain authored in the canonical Wiki.
Home compresses the state → detail pages prove claims → Wiki and immutable artifacts remain canonical.

svg.text: Prototype structure v0.1 · high-level SVG · intentionally read-only · no invented telemetry
